subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should ordered `agent:bootstrap` handlers remain one uninterrupted dispatch, or may unrelated event-loop work run between handlers?
rationale: The patch preserves registration order but changes the atomicity of mutations to a shared bootstrap event; repository history and the supplied loader proof do not establish that lifecycle policy.

options.title: Keep handler-chain atomic
options.body: Remove between-handler yielding while retaining asynchronous file reads, cooperative glob traversal, handler timing, and slow-handler diagnostics.

options.title: Allow cooperative interleaving
options.body: Keep the yields and explicitly document and test that unrelated event-loop work may run between ordered bootstrap handlers.

recommendation.title: Keep handler-chain atomic
recommendation.body: Remove between-handler yielding while retaining asynchronous file reads, cooperative glob traversal, handler timing, and slow-handler diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame ties him to both the bootstrap hook composition and the sequential internal-hook dispatch contract changed here.
